warnings: Test set is ~balanced by construction. Use precision_at_realistic_prevalence, not raw precision, to describe what a user sees on real dependency trees.
Malicious samples come from public datasets dominated by automated campaigns; targeted attacks are likely harder. Registry metadata is intentionally unused because it exists only for benign packages.

selected.model: xgboost_d3 | all content + anomaly (hybrid) | hard-negative weight x5
selected.selection_rule: highest validation PR-AUC (tie: recall at 0.1% FPR); thresholds = best recall under 1% / 0.1% false positives on validation

grouped_cv_all_data.note: 5-fold, every campaign held out once; threshold chosen on the same out-of-fold scores (slightly optimistic for recall). Shows how much the result depends on WHICH campaigns are unseen.
